pages.title: Social Threader – Perfectly Sized Social Media Threads
pages.description: Split your text into platform-friendly chunks. Social Threader is a free, fast tool for creating perfectly sized social media threads.

pages.title: Social Threader Resources for Better Thread Writing
pages.description: Practical, repository-backed guides for splitting long text, preserving sentences, adapting character limits, handling images, and using JavaScript.

pages.title: Split Text Without Breaking Sentences | Social Threader
pages.description: Split long text into character-limited chunks while preserving sentence and paragraph boundaries. Follow a tested Social Threader workflow.
pages.audience: People adapting essays, announcements, and multi-paragraph writing for social threads
pages.conversionGoal: Split a long draft with sentence or paragraph boundaries
pages.differentiation: Focuses on readable linguistic boundaries, abbreviations, decimals, ellipses, and over-limit sentences rather than platform comparison.
allowedClaims: Social Threader can prefer sentence and paragraph boundaries.
Every resulting text chunk stays within the selected maximum length.
The tested sentence heuristic handles documented abbreviations, decimals, and ellipses.
forbiddenClaims: Perfect sentence detection in every language

pages.title: Social Media Character Limit Splitter | Social Threader
pages.description: Compare 280, 300, 500, and custom character limits, then adapt one source text into readable threads with Social Threader.
pages.audience: People adapting the same source text for multiple character-limited platforms
pages.conversionGoal: Compare preset output and choose the right limit
pages.differentiation: Uses one source draft to compare 280, 300, 500, and custom output instead of teaching a single-platform posting workflow.
allowedClaims: The web app provides 280, 300, 500, and custom character-limit controls.
Enumeration reserves room inside the selected maximum.
Users copy the resulting chunks manually.
forbiddenClaims: Guaranteed current platform policies beyond the configured presets

pages.title: Twitter Thread Splitter Tool for 280-Character Posts
pages.description: Turn long text into 280-character thread posts, reserve room for numbering, and copy each chunk in order with Social Threader.
pages.audience: People preparing manually posted X or Twitter threads
pages.conversionGoal: Create and copy a numbered 280-character thread
pages.differentiation: Concentrates on the 280-character preset, numbering overhead, copy sequence, and manual posting rather than general character-limit comparison.
allowedClaims: The Twitter/X preset uses a 280-character maximum.
Numbering is included within the maximum length.
Copied chunks receive visible sequence markers.
forbiddenClaims: Direct posting to X or Twitter

pages.title: Create Image and Text Social Threads | Social Threader
pages.description: Build image-and-text threads with ordered chunks, browser clipboard support, mobile image picking, and honest compatibility guidance.
pages.audience: People preparing screenshot, diagram, or image-led social threads
pages.conversionGoal: Arrange and copy a mixed image-and-text thread
pages.differentiation: Documents image anchoring, web and mobile input differences, rich clipboard behavior, and compatibility limitations.
allowedClaims: Pasted or dropped browser images become separate ordered chunks.
The mobile app can select images and copy image payloads.
Text-only copying remains available when rich clipboard behavior is restricted.
forbiddenClaims: Automatic image upload to social networks

pages.title: JavaScript: Split Text by Character Limit | Threader
pages.description: Learn how Social Threader splits text by character limit in JavaScript while preserving words, sentences, paragraphs, and numbering space.
pages.primaryKeyword: split text by character limit in JavaScript
secondaryKeywords: split long strings without breaking words
pages.audience: Developers studying or adapting a browser-based text chunking algorithm
pages.conversionGoal: Inspect the open-source implementation and try the working tool
pages.differentiation: Explains the actual ES-module algorithm, configuration contract, enumeration loop, and tested edge cases without presenting it as a published package.
allowedClaims: The chunking engine is an ES module in the public repository.
The engine accepts maximum length, sentence, paragraph, and enumeration options.
Repository tests cover documented boundary and punctuation cases.
